title: Lenovo Legion R27qe Gen 2
description: The Lenovo Legion R27qe Gen 2 is a 27-inch QHD IPS gaming monitor designed for fast, smooth gameplay and everyday productivity. It offers a 200Hz refresh rate, up to 0.5ms response time, AMD FreeSync/G-SYNC compatibility, vivid 99% sRGB colour coverage, and a fully adjustable stand with height, tilt, swivel, and pivot controls.
